techniques.name: Animation canceling
steps: Training room: try roll-canceling, dismount-canceling and blocking on every skill to learn which are cancelable.
techniques.rhythm: Amya: EVERY CLASS CAN DO IT! - Blocking is the primary cancel; roll canceling interrupts full spells, dismounts, and creates movement otherwise impossible. Costs extra stamina.

techniques.name: Active blocking
steps: it can be BROKEN and stagger you
techniques.rhythm: Don't get "Block checked" - Being an active blocker prevents undesired skills landing on you. Short Bow carries no shield of its own ("You don't have a shield", b12 PDF), so this is a fallback tool rather than a kit centerpiece here.

techniques.name: Horse-whistle CC immunity
steps: Time the whistle on the enemy CC
you take damage but no CC
techniques.rhythm: bugs out with PIN/LOCK skills, so care

techniques.name: Walk into braced units
steps: Walk (don't sprint) into their minimal range
techniques.rhythm: brace damage scales with your speed towards them - For braced units like Forte, Halberds, Phalanx - of limited relevance to Short Bow, a kiting ranged class that generally avoids walking into braced units at all.

techniques.name: AA-spell rotation
steps: If you run out of spell rotation, jump immediately after each AA instead for the same DPS-preserving effect.
techniques.rhythm: spells cancel animations = more DPS - Between every AA you send one spell, rotating the best you can as spell will cancel the animations and you will have more DPS. Both builds rely on hitting a spell, marking the enemy with a poison stack, then making it explode with AA.

techniques.name: Kite and reposition
techniques.rhythm: core to Shortbow's hit-and-run identity - Exceptional agility and multiple dodge/movement skills let it kite heavier enemies easily.

gameplay.text: It trades the Longbow's raw power for higher attack speed, mobility, and damage over time. Shortbow heroes excel at killing enemy heroes.
In comparison to the bow, the short bow is less cumbersome and tiring, suited to scouts and other light infantry.

roleLabel: The Shortbow in Conqueror's Blade is a nimble ranged Hero class which shines in close-to-mid range combat.

positioning.intro: Where to be during a fight:

bullets.text: fight around a ~5-10 meter sweet spot - inside ~5m you risk getting melee'd, beyond ~10-15m your damage/accuracy fall off.
no shield, so lean on the environment instead - peek out from behind walls, siege engines, or rocks to fire, then duck back into cover if enenmy is focusing you. Pop out, take a few shots, then move.
Fragile - cannot survive direct focus or melee range. Short effective range means you fight closer to danger than other ranged classes.
poison-mark-then-AA-detonate can hit any target for -40% to -60% of their HP, but kills get harder to close out as the target's HP% drops - damage falls off heavily at low HP.
Angry Hornets has a wide splash - don't fire it at a target that hasn't closed distance yet, or the spread is wasted.
practice landing critical headshot damage, especially on stationary or unaware targets.
don't only think of yourself as DPS - remember your utility.
No lengthy cooldown gates the whole kit - most skills recharge quickly, so the poke-burst-reposition loop is meant to repeat continuously rather than being a single burst window.
CC loadout is still being tuned - stunt arrow + bola simultaneously "may be better," adapt to your liking rather than a settled answer.
Male gender pick is contingent on Short Bow currently allowing a gender choice at all, which is not confirmed - see the gender field below.
